_about: Stage 6 (Energy Zone): segment length as a function of the global frame counter $1A & 127 on the stage's first playable frame. cluster_frames = MEASURED solver time from world x 1300 to 1900 (three flame towers) at that phase (scan made from a checkpoint of a full solve with a leading pause to set the phase; the pause is not counted). predicted_segment = prefix + cluster + suffix from the verified full solves listed in 'full_solves' (suffix_best = luckiest boss seen, suffix_median = typical). wait_only_estimate = what the towers would cost with no pause at all, computed from the no-remedy windows (not played). Made by tools/s6_phase_table.py.
